svg.title: Regime Engine Level 4 and Level 5 Architecture
svg.desc: Level 4: 4 inputs through Feature Prep, 3-state HMM and BOCPD in parallel, combined into probability output with size scalar. Level 5 adds RS-GARCH, multi-dimensional regimes, forecasting, and GBM ensemble.
svg.text: StandardScaler normalisation · Stationarity check · Forward-fill stale data · Remove NaNs
All 4 inputs → scaled feature matrix X[t] = [context_score, returns, rv, gex]
State 0: Bull Trend · State 1: Bear Trend
Output: P(bull), P(bear), P(range) per timestep
Fires when regime is actively changing
Does NOT wait for HMM to refit
LEVEL 5 — WORLD CLASS UPGRADES (delta from L4)
Each regime has its own GARCH process
Separate HMM: vol regime + correlation regime
Each runs independently, outputs own probs
High persistence → hold longer, wider stops
Low persistence → tighten stops, exit sooner
GBM trained on labeled historical regimes
SHAP: which signal drove today's regime
Interpretable + auditable for Tier C interviews
